cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Say You’re Sorry
cards.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put your usual mug out. I taught you that tea can follow a difficult conversation, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are we having a difficult conversation? You look cross.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're noticing faces now. What could you say before I pour?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry you feel that way.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nearly. Keep 'I'm sorry' and start again from there. You don't need to describe my feelings; I already have them.
